title: MinecraftWoow Modpack
description: A simple optimized Modpack for Vanilla survival.
body:

With the optimization mods, We also added Jade, Xaero Maps, InventoryHUD, Freecam and Zume to ensure the necessary auxiliary mods for survival. ![In Game UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea6fb4c5d882ebd0e9294016316ae54017ed7a45.png) Here is showing what mods are added
